name: Bergamot (Citrus bergamia)
summary: Citrus bergamot polyphenols (distinct from bergamot essential oil) have RCT support for LDL, triglyceride, and NAFLD-marker improvements. The lipid effects are described as statin-adjacent in the research literature.
description: Canonical Bergamot (Citrus bergamia) research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until trial-specific efficacy, formulation, dose, longer-term safety, and outcome-boundary evidence has passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: LDL cholesterol; triglycerides; NAFLD markers; citrus polyphenols

research_metadata.evidence_notes: RCTs on LDL, triglycerides, NAFLD markers (PMIDs flagged verify-before-publishing).
